defects.description: The term 'Name servers' is incorrectly translated as 'Имена серверов' (Names of servers), changing the meaning of the subject.

The required glossary term 'авторитетный сервер имён' is replaced by 'авторитативные имена серверов', which is both a terminology violation and a linguistic error ('авторитативные' is not the correct adjective for 'authoritative' in this context).
The required glossary term 'кэширующий сервер имён' is replaced by 'кэширующие... имена серверов'.
defects.quote: кэширующие (также известные как разрешающие) имена серверов

defects.description: Awkward phrasing and grammatical mismatch when integrating the glossary term 'Обратная запись DNS' into the phrase 'reverse DNS entries'.
Grammatical case error: 'Конфигурация' is in the nominative case, but the context requires the prepositional case ('конфигурации'). Additionally, unnecessary bolding was added.
